title: Shutting the owner down
hints: After Close, the owner goroutine has exited, so nobody will ever receive on c.incs. A plain send in Inc blocks forever. Make the send a select that also watches c.done.
Close should close quit (so the owner exits) and then wait on done, which the owner closes as it exits. Then Inc can select { case c.incs <- resp: …; case <-c.done: return 0, ErrClosed }.
Inc: resp := make(chan int); select { case c.incs <- resp: return <-resp, nil; case <-c.done: return 0, ErrClosed }.  Close: close(c.quit); <-c.done.  The owner: defer close(c.done).
